jobs.title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

As an engineer in the Infrastructure department at Alchemy, you will design, deploy, and continuously improve the infrastructure powering our blockchain developer platform — serving 100+ chains, billions of daily requests, and over $150B in annual transactions.

The Infrastructure team provides the infrastructure, tooling, and expertise needed to allow Alchemy engineers to ship, scale, and operate high-quality products in a fast, safe, and cost-efficient manner.

What You'll Do

  • Architect and operate scalable, self-healing infrastructure leveraging Kubernetes, Terraform, and cloud-native tools across multi-region deployments.

  • Drive AI enablement across engineering — ensuring repos, tooling, and workflows are optimized for agentic development with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.

  • Build AI-powered infrastructure tooling and automation (e.g., automated K8s upgrades, IaC plan analysis, cost optimization advisors, MCP servers, n8n workflows).

  • Build and maintain internal developer platform (IDP) capabilities for self-service deployments, observability, and reliability.

  • Develop observability frameworks using Prometheus and Grafana for metrics, dashboards, and alerting.

  • Lead incident management with blameless post-mortems; define and enforce SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets across services.

  • Design and manage multi-cloud, multi-region network architecture — VPC design, IPAM, DNS (Cloudflare), cross-cloud connectivity, security groups, and edge-proxy/istio gateway configuration.

  • Collaborate with security teams to embed compliance into infrastructure, including IaC scanning and runtime protection.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to elevate the team's operational capabilities.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years as an Infrastructure Engineer focused on reliability (SRE, Production Engineer, Platform Engineer).

  • Experience driving company-wide reliability efforts, including SLO frameworks and error budget policies.

  • Strong proficiency with observability stacks: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana.

  • Deep experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), Kubernetes, and multi-region architectures.

  • Skilled with Terraform, Helm, and GitOps workflows (e.g., ArgoCD) with an automation-first mindset.

  • Experience leveraging agentic development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) and workflow automation (n8n) to accelerate IaC and build internal tooling is a strong plus.

  • Solid networking fundamentals — VPC design, DNS, IPAM, security groups, cross-cloud connectivity, and service mesh (e.g., Istio) experience is a plus.

  • Strong cross-functional communicator across SRE, security, and product engineering.

  • Blockchain infrastructure, distributed systems, or high-throughput RPC experience — not required but a plus.

Benefits and Perks

🩺 Medical, Dental, & Vision

💪 Gym Reimbursement

🖥️ Home Office Build-out Budget

🥙 In-Office Group Meals

🧘‍♂️ Wellbeing & Mental Health Perks

📚 Learning & Development Stipend

🎉 Company Sponsored Conferences & Events

💸 HSA and FSA Plans

🧬 Fertility Benefits

More on the Role

Alchemy is committed to offering competitive compensation, including base salary as well as equity. Additionally, Alchemy offers comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as other benefits such as 401k and unlimited flexible time off.

jobs.title: Controller
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Alchemy

Alchemy is the Web3 infrastructure and developer platform that powers millions of users and the world’s most innovative blockchain applications. From enabling $1+ trillion in financial transactions worldwide to scaling L2s and enabling DeFi, Alchemy provides the infrastructure and tools developers need to build reliable, scalable, and accessible experiences.

Trusted by companies like JPMorgan, Stripe, Visa, Franklin Templeton, Nike, and backed by a16z, Coatue, Silver Lake, Lightspeed, and Stanford University, Alchemy is building the foundational layer for a decentralized and AI-enabled Web3 ecosystem. For more information, visit alchemy.com.

About the Role

As Controller at Alchemy, you'll be responsible for building and leading our end-to-end accounting function.

Leading a growing team, you’ll be responsible for our core accounting operations, strengthening the systems and controls that support the business, and transforming complex financial information into clear insights for company leadership, our Board of Directors, and investors. The ideal candidate combines deep technical accounting expertise with strong business judgment. You’ll be equally comfortable setting the long-term direction of the function, partnering across the company, and rolling up your sleeves to solve challenging accounting and operational problems.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Set the strategy and long-term direction for Alchemy’s accounting function, systems, and team.

  • Assume full responsibility for routine financial operations, encompassing the general ledger, AP, AR, and reporting, while managing complex multi-entity and multi-currency consolidations for global operations, including our presence in Romania.

  • Own timely and accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes.

  • Ensure financial statements and accounting practices comply with US GAAP and applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Architect and refine a scalable accounting infrastructure by managing and optimizing our core financial technology stack, including NetSuite, Orb, Zip, and Ramp.

  • Develop policies, procedures, and controls that promote financial accuracy, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and strong risk management.

  • Oversee tax planning, compliance, and preparation in partnership with internal stakeholders and external advisors.

  • Lead relationships with third-party accounting firms, auditors, tax advisors, and other financial service providers.

  • Develop and present reporting that gives company leaders meaningful insight into financial and operational performance, and partner with Finance on Board and investor reporting.

  • Distill complex financial information into clear recommendations that support strategic decision-making.

  • Lead technical accounting and strategic initiatives, including revenue recognition, vendor analysis, customer analysis, and other special projects.

  • Collaborate closely with teams across Alchemy, including Finance, Operations, Sales, People, Engineering, and Product.

  • Lead, develop, and scale the capabilities of a high-performing accounting team, fostering ownership, rigor, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

 

What we’re looking for

  • 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, with leadership experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, Head of Accounting, Accounting Director, or similar senior accounting role.

  • Public accounting experience paired with meaningful in-house operating experience at a high-growth technology company.

  • Strong ownership of accounting operations, including general ledger, AP, AR, consolidations, financial reporting, and close processes.

  • Deep technical accounting knowledge, including US GAAP and experience applying accounting guidance to complex business transactions.

  • Experience building scalable accounting systems, processes, policies, and internal controls with a focus on accuracy, timeliness, and scalability.

  • Audit-readiness experience or strong ability to prepare a company for future audits, including documentation, controls, reporting infrastructure, and close discipline.

  • Strong business judgment, with the ability to connect detailed accounting work to broader company strategy and decision-making.

  • Hands-on operating style, comfortable rolling up their sleeves in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to partner cross-functionally and explain complex financial topics clearly to leadership, Board members, investors, and cross-functional partners.

  • People leadership experience, including leading, developing, and raising the bar for an accounting team.

 

Nice to Haves

  • CPA strongly preferred.

  • Experience in a high-growth startup or later-stage private company, ideally Series C/D/E.

  • NetSuite experience preferred but not required.

  • Experience with billing, procurement, and expense management systems.

  • Experience with crypto, digital assets, blockchain, or web3 is a plus, but not required.

  • Experience managing external tax, technical accounting, M&A, audit, or advisory partners.

 

Benefits and Perks

🏥 Medical, Dental, & Vision
💪 Gym Reimbursement
🖥️ Home Office Build-out Budget
🥙 In-Office Group Meals
🚅 Commuter Benefits
🌴 Flexible Time Off

🧠 Learning & Development Stipend
🌎 Company Sponsored Conferences & Events
💸 HSA and FSA Plans
🧬 Fertility Benefits

jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Role

Alchemy powers the most innovative companies in crypto - from Robinhood and Coinbase to Worldcoin and Stripe. As a Software Engineer focused on Solutions, you'll work directly with our most strategic customers to help them design scalable systems, optimize performance, and push the boundaries of what’s possible in blockchain infrastructure.

You’ll be a strategic advisor, systems architect, and product collaborator rolled into one. You’ll bridge the gap between bleeding-edge use cases and robust infrastructure, shaping the future of Alchemy through your insights on real-world needs.

Be the technical partner behind Web3’s most ambitious teams.

What You’ll Do

  • Write code to help users unlock the full potential of our stack.

  • Help top-tier teams design, scale, and optimize their use of Alchemy’s infrastructure - from smart contract automation to custom data pipelines.

  • Deeply understand customer goals and proactively help them onboard, integrate, and ship powerful products on top of our infrastructure.

  • Be the voice of our developer community - translate their needs into product insights and roadmap priorities.

  • Act as the technical point of contact for strategic accounts, navigating technical blockers, future planning, and success metrics.

  • Work across Product, Engineering, and BD to uplevel the full user experience and close feedback loops fast.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in technical roles (Software Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or similar)

  • Strong foundation in systems design, APIs, and distributed architecture

  • Experience working directly with customers - ideally in B2B SaaS or infra

  • Comfortable writing and reading code - Python, TypeScript, or similar scripting languages

  • Stellar communicator who can translate technical concepts for both builders and execs

  • Passion for blockchain, crypto, and the infrastructure powering it - you don’t need to be a degen, but you’re curious and hungry to learn

  • Bonus: experience at a high-growth startup or scaling a product in a fast-moving environment

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Alchemy

Alchemy is the Web3 infrastructure and developer platform that powers millions of users and the world’s most innovative blockchain applications. From enabling $1+ trillion in financial transactions worldwide to scaling L2s and enabling DeFi, Alchemy provides the infrastructure and tools developers need to build reliable, scalable, and accessible experiences.

Trusted by companies like JPMorgan, Stripe, Visa, Franklin Templeton, Nike, and backed by a16z, Coatue, Silver Lake, Lightspeed, and Stanford University, Alchemy is building the foundational layer for a decentralized and AI-enabled Web3 ecosystem. For more information, visit alchemy.com.

About The Role

As a Product Designer you'll sit at the intersection of product design, product thinking, and front-end engineering—someone who can take early, ambiguous ideas and turn them into interactive, evaluable experiences fast, helping teams make better decisions sooner.

This role is front-end and systems-heavy, with a strong balance of hands-on building and product design partnership. You’ll help us scale and evolve Alchemy’s UI system—owning core components, patterns, and implementation quality—while also jumping into product work when needed to unblock teams and raise the craft bar.

This is a high-leverage role: you’ll reduce handoff friction, increase prototype velocity, and elevate UI quality through hands-on building, close collaboration, and a strong point of view on systems.

What You'll Do

  • Build production-quality prototypes (and, when appropriate, ship production front-end code) to validate UX direction quickly—often on tight timelines.

  • Own and evolve Alchemy’s design system in practice: build and maintain reusable components, patterns, and interaction primitives that scale across products.

  • Translate design intent into high-quality React/TypeScript UI, with attention to spacing, hierarchy, motion, and interaction polish.

  • Drive system scalability: identify gaps, propose improvements, and ship additions that make the product ecosystem more consistent and faster to build.

  • Partner closely with product designers to improve the craft and feasibility of design work—bringing an engineer’s pragmatism and a designer’s taste.

  • Collaborate tightly with product engineers to reduce rework and make the path from prototype → implementation smoother.

  • Improve “how we build UI” muscle across teams: documentation, examples, and workflow improvements that raise the baseline.

  • Build for an AI-native product future: create interaction patterns and UI foundations that support rapid experimentation and iteration in AI-driven experiences.

  • Contribute to design-system adoption and quality: tokens/components/docs, accessibility standards, and tooling (e.g., Storybook) when needed.

  • Help teams iterate in short cycles (e.g., ~5–10 day “idea → prototype → decision” loops), bringing clarity to what’s possible and what’s worth building.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong front-end fundamentals and comfort building interactive UI (e.g., React + TypeScript; equivalent stacks welcome).

  • Systems-minded builder: you’ve shipped and maintained component libraries / design systems (tokens, components, documentation, adoption).

  • A designer’s eye: you care about hierarchy, spacing, typography, interaction details, and visual polish.

  • Proven ability to prototype quickly without sacrificing craft—and to choose the right fidelity for the question at hand.

  • Ability to operate in ambiguity and move fast with high ownership.

  • Clear communicator across disciplines; you can translate between design intent and technical constraints.

  • Bonus: accessibility fluency, Storybook (or similar), motion/animation experience, and experience scaling design systems across multiple product surfaces.

Benefits and Perks 

🩺  Medical, Dental, & Vision
💪  Gym Reimbursement
🖥️  Home Office Build-out Budget
🥙  In-Office Group Meals
🧘‍♂️  Wellbeing & Mental Health Perks
📚 Learning & Development Stipend
🎉  Company Sponsored Conferences & Events
💸  HSA and FSA Plans
🧬  Fertility Benefits

More on the Role

Alchemy is committed to offering competitive compensation, including base salary as well as equity. Additionally, Alchemy offers comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as other benefits such as 401k and unlimited flexible time off.

The base salary range for this position is estimated to be between $180,000 - $210,000 annually. Please note this range reflects base salary only, and does not include bonus, equity, or benefits. Your salary will be determined by various factors, including relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business needs.

About The Role

We're looking for a Growth PM who can own the next chapter of how Alchemy grows. This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role at the intersection of product, engineering, and go-to-market — and the surface area is expanding fast. Our AI agent platform lets autonomous software create wallets, pay for API access in real time, and operate fully on-chain, opening up an entirely new category of user to acquire, activate, and retain. You'll bring structure to ambiguity, move fast, and build something that compounds.

You'll have full end-to-end ownership of the growth motion — strategy, experimentation, and the number. You'll have a direct line to leadership, high visibility across the org, and the resources to move fast and make a real dent.

  • Own the full growth funnel — set the strategy, define the metrics, and drive acquisition, activation, retention, and expansion across our developer platform

  • Identify and build the compounding loops that turn great developer experience into organic growth — referrals, word of mouth, community, virality

jobs.title: Senior Ecosystem Marketing Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Alchemy

Alchemy is the Web3 infrastructure and developer platform that powers millions of users and the world’s most innovative blockchain applications. From enabling $1+ trillion in financial transactions worldwide to scaling L2s and enabling DeFi, Alchemy provides the infrastructure and tools developers need to build reliable, scalable, and accessible experiences.

Trusted by companies like JPMorgan, Stripe, Visa, Franklin Templeton, Nike, and backed by a16z, Coatue, Silver Lake, Lightspeed, and Stanford University, Alchemy is building the foundational layer for a decentralized and AI-enabled Web3 ecosystem. For more information, visit alchemy.com.

 

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Ecosystem Marketing Manager to own and scale Alchemy's presence across the Web3 ecosystem—spanning chain partnerships, infrastructure providers, channel partners, customers, and emerging verticals like traditional finance and agentic commerce.

Alchemy is the AWS of blockchain. We power everyone from Azuki and Polymarket to JP Morgan and Robinhood. This role sits at the intersection of all of those relationships and has the unique mandate to build deep, strategic connections across the entire ecosystem—then turn those relationships into high-impact co-marketing programs, joint campaigns, thought leadership, and distribution at scale.

This role has extraordinary breadth. You'll develop and execute strategy across Web3-native partners (chains, protocols, infrastructure providers), traditional finance institutions entering onchain (JP Morgan, Visa, MasterCard), customers, and channel partners (AWS and beyond). You'll also keep a pulse on the frontiers of blockchain—stablecoins, RWA tokenization, deposit tokens, institutional staking, and agentic commerce—positioning Alchemy as the infrastructure layer that makes it all possible.

This is a senior, strategic role. We're looking for someone who already has existing relationships across the ecosystem and a proven track record of expanding their network, developing a distribution strategy, and executing it at scale. You won't be building a network from scratch—you'll be activating one.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and own the ecosystem marketing strategy across chain partnerships, infrastructure partners, channel partners (e.g., AWS), and key customers spanning Web3 native and TradFi verticals.

  • Build and deepen strategic relationships with ecosystem players, including chains, protocols (Chainlink, Fireblocks, Canton Network), technology partners, and enterprise customers, to create mutual distribution opportunities.

  • Design and execute joint campaigns, co-branded content, co-hosted events, and thought leadership programs that amplify Alchemy's brand across partner channels and audiences.

  • Drive ecosystem distribution at scale by identifying and activating opportunities to leverage partner channels (newsletters, events, social, developer communities) to expand Alchemy's reach and brand awareness.

  • Host and coordinate thought leadership workshops, panels, and executive roundtables with key ecosystem players to reinforce Alchemy's position as the foundational infrastructure layer for onchain development.

  • Keep a pulse on the TradFi to onchain movement, tracking how institutions like JP Morgan, Visa, MasterCard, and Coinbase are adopting blockchain and identifying marketing opportunities at the intersection of traditional finance and Web3.

  • Monitor and engage with emerging trends including stablecoins, RWA tokenization, deposit tokens, institutional staking, and agentic commerce (AI agents on blockchain rails), positioning Alchemy as the infrastructure powering these movements.

  • Collaborate cross functionally with Product Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, and Content to ensure ecosystem marketing efforts are tightly aligned with Alchemy's GTM strategy and revenue goals.

  • Build and maintain a comprehensive ecosystem map, tracking key players, partnership health, co-marketing pipeline, and campaign impact across verticals.

  • Report on ecosystem marketing performance, providing clear metrics and insights to leadership on brand awareness, partner engagement, and pipeline contribution.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience in ecosystem marketing, partner marketing, or strategic marketing within crypto, blockchain, or developer infrastructure.

  • Existing relationships across the Web3 ecosystem, including chains, protocols, infrastructure providers, and key industry players. You are not starting from zero.

  • Proven track record of developing an ecosystem or partner marketing strategy and distributing it at scale, driving measurable brand awareness, partner engagement, and pipeline impact.

  • Experience executing joint campaigns, co-marketing programs, and events with ecosystem partners that drove real business outcomes.

  • Strong understanding of the blockchain landscape, including L1s/L2s, DeFi, infrastructure, wallets, and the developer tooling ecosystem.

  • Working knowledge of TradFi's onchain adoption, with familiarity around how institutions are approaching stablecoins, tokenization, and blockchain based settlement.

  • Awareness of emerging trends in agentic commerce and AI powered onchain transactions.

  • Exceptional relationship building and communication skills, with the ability to navigate conversations with chain foundations, protocol teams, enterprise partners, and C-suite executives with equal comfort.

  • Strong cross functional collaborator with a proven ability to work closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Partnerships, Content, and Engineering to align ecosystem efforts with company wide priorities and drive unified go-to-market execution.

  • Strategic thinker who can also execute, comfortable building a plan from scratch and rolling up sleeves to ship campaigns, host events, and manage partner activations.

  • Self-starter mentality with extreme ownership who thrives in fast paced, high autonomy environments.

Nice to Haves

  • Ability to be in office in SF or NYC 3x a week.

  • Experience at a blockchain infrastructure company, chain foundation, or developer platform.

  • Previous experience marketing to both Web3-native and enterprise/TradFi audiences.

  • Familiarity with Alchemy's product suite (RPC, Gasless Transactions, Data APIs, Webhooks, etc.).

  • Experience managing or influencing channel partnerships with major cloud/tech providers (AWS, GCP, etc.).

  • Background in developer relations or developer-focused marketing.

  • Existing presence and influence on Crypto Twitter / X and within key Web3 communities.

Benefits and Perks

🏥 Medical, Dental, & Vision
💪 Gym Reimbursement
🖥️ Home Office Build-out Budget
🥙 In-Office Group Meals
🚅 Commuter Benefits
🌴 Flexible Time Off
🧘‍♂️ Wellbeing & Mental Health Perks
🧠 Learning & Development Stipend
🌎 Company Sponsored Conferences & Events
💸 HSA and FSA Plans
🧬 Fertility Benefits

 

Alchemy is committed to offering competitive compensation, including base salary as well as bonus and equity. Additionally, Alchemy offers comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as other benefits such as 401k and unlimited flexible time off.

Self-serve is how Alchemy grows. The dashboard and the developer experience around it are the primary revenue engine for our flagship products: developers discover us, sign up, get to their first call, scale their usage, and upgrade largely without ever talking to a person. That funnel is one of the most direct levers on company-level revenue we have, and this role owns it.

It's also changing fast. A growing share of developers now reach Alchemy through an AI coding agent rather than a browser tab, and we expect agent-mediated usage to become the dominant way our platform is consumed. Building for that shift, our MCP server, agent skills, and AI-native onboarding, sits squarely in this role.

You'll run the dashboard as a product, own the self-serve growth engine, and set the experimentation and measurement standard for growth across the company, partnering with Node APIs, Data APIs, Wallets, Transaction Engine, Growth Marketing, and Billing, and spending meaningful time with customers.

What you'll own

  • The dashboard. Own signup, app creation, first key, first call, usage and CU visibility, upgrade paths, team management, and the observability developers need to debug their own traffic.

  • Developer experience end to end. Docs, SDKs, quickstarts, error messages, sandbox and testnet flows, and the first hour of every integration. Reduce time to first successful call, then time to first paid workload.

  • Own product-led growth end to end. Design the developer journey from docs, to first API call, to first paid workload, to scaled production spend. Instrument it, find the drop-offs, fix them.

  • Agent experience (AX). Make Alchemy the default infrastructure an AI coding agent reaches for. Own how our MCP server, agent skills, and machine readable docs perform inside Claude Code, Cursor, and whatever comes next.

  • Experimentation. Building the A/B and holdout tooling, running pricing, packaging, and onboarding tests, and creating a habit of shipping and learning weekly rather than quarterly.

  • The truth. Get into the warehouse yourself. Build the funnel, find the cohort that doesn't behave like the average, and bring back the answer nobody wanted to hear.

    What we're looking for

    • 10+ years in product, with deep time on developer platforms, APIs, or infrastructure, and direct ownership of a dashboard or console that developers use daily.

    • Proven product-led growth leadership: you've owned a self-serve funnel at scale and can show what you moved, by how much, and how you know it was you.

    • Rigorous experimentation practice. You know the difference between a lift and a fluke, you size tests before you run them, and you've built the culture as much as the tooling.

    • Genuinely analytical. Data Analysis is a normal Tuesday. You can build the model, audit the instrumentation, catch the bad join, and defend the number in front of the exec team.

    • Truth seeking. You'd rather be corrected in week one than right in a deck in week twelve. You go looking for the disconfirming data.

    • Cross functional gravity. You've driven outcomes across engineering, design, docs, marketing, sales, and finance without owning any of them.

    • Customer facing by instinct. You run your own discovery calls, sit in support channels, and can walk a CTO through an integration and a pricing model in the same meeting.

    • Technical enough to build with our own APIs, prototype with AI agents, and read the code when the answer isn't in the dashboard.

You'll own a 0→1 product surface at Alchemy, from the first customer conversation to GA to a self-serve growth engine. This is a builder's seat. You'll have real latitude to shape the roadmap, so this role suits someone who's comfortable defining the problem as well as solving it

What you'll do

  • Go 0→1. Take an ambiguous opportunity such as agentic payments, stablecoin rails, data APIs, or a new chain ecosystem, and turn it into a shipped product with real usage and real revenue.

  • Sell, build, and deliver. Run discovery calls, join sales calls, write the pitch, then go build what you promised and make sure it lands in production.

  • Be the voice of the developer. Live in support channels, GitHub issues, customer Slack channels, and your own terminal. Ship product that engineers choose without a sales call.

  • Set the bar on quality and speed. Define what great looks like for latency, reliability, and DX, then hold the line while moving fast.

  • Make the call. Decide with incomplete information, write down why, and revisit when the data changes.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in product, with meaningful time on a developer platform, API, or infrastructure product. You've shipped things engineers integrate, not just use.

  • Demonstrated product-led growth experience: self-serve funnels, activation and conversion metrics, pricing and packaging, usage-based monetization.

  • Founder mentality. You've started something, whether a company, a business line, or a product nobody asked you to build.

  • Bias to action. You move quickly to get to a real answer: fast customer validation, clear evidence of demand, then a committed build with a path to revenue. Speed comes from cutting cycle time, not from cutting quality.

  • Customer obsessed and commercially fluent. Comfortable in a sales call, a design review, and a production incident on the same day.

  • Thrives in ambiguity. You create the structure rather than wait for it.

About Alchemy

Alchemy is the Web3 infrastructure and developer platform that powers millions of users and the world’s most innovative blockchain applications. From enabling $1+ trillion in financial transactions worldwide to scaling L2s and enabling DeFi, Alchemy provides the infrastructure and tools developers need to build reliable, scalable, and accessible experiences.

Trusted by companies like JPMorgan, Stripe, Visa, Franklin Templeton, Nike, and backed by a16z, Coatue, Silver Lake, Lightspeed, and Stanford University, Alchemy is building the foundational layer for a decentralized and AI-enabled Web3 ecosystem. For more information, visit alchemy.com.

 

About the Role

We're looking for a Growth Marketing Lead to shape where Alchemy invests growth: full-funnel, from self-serve signup all the way through the enterprise sales funnel. This is a high-ownership, strategic seat. You'll decide, each cycle, where our marketing dollars and headcount go for the highest return, and you'll have real influence over the tactics we run to get there.

This role has real breadth. You'll own the channel mix we run today, paid search, paid social, SEO, AEO, a lifecycle program we're just getting off the ground, and our website, and you'll decide where each of those gets more or less investment based on what's actually driving signups and pipeline. You'll also go looking for what's next: new channels worth testing as the audience and the industry evolve, and product-led signals worth turning into a marketing motion. And you'll bring visibility to parts of the funnel we can't see well today, both self-serve and the enterprise sales flow, so the whole company can make better calls on where to spend.

This is a senior, strategic role. We're looking for someone who's already built full-funnel growth measurement from scratch at a developer-focused B2B company, and who knows how to rank channels by ROI and act on it. You won't be building a growth program from zero, you'll be evolving one: an AI-powered SEO/AEO system already in production, a defined tool stack, and agencies already engaged. You'll decide what stays, what goes, and where you build a team to get us to the next level of growth maturity.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own full-funnel visibility for Alchemy's growth motion, from self-serve signup through the enterprise sales flow, including the quality of leads reaching the sales team, so the company can see how every channel performs end to end.

  • Set the channel investment strategy each half: given current resourcing and goals, decide where marketing dollars and efforts go, and defend that call with data.

  • Own and continuously re-rank channel ROI, paid search, paid social, SEO, AEO, lifecycle/email, website, ecosystem/partner-driven channels, and any new channel you stand up, identifying the highest-ROI area each cycle and reallocating toward it.

  • Evaluate and evolve the existing tool stack and agencies: keep, renegotiate, or replace based on what's actually driving signups and pipeline.

  • Identify, pitch, and test new channels and signals, including product-led growth signals you pick up working with Product, as Alchemy's audience and the industry evolve, then scope and delegate what you find to the right owner: a product marketer, an ecosystem marketing manager, an agency, or your own hire.

  • Build and lead a team over time: propose and open headcount as the highest-ROI areas demand dedicated ownership, and directly manage the specialists and agencies you bring on.

  • Represent growth and channel performance in the twice-yearly marketing planning cycle and retro, as a primary voice in where the company focuses its tactics next half, backed by your own data.

What we’re looking for

  • 8+ years in growth or performance marketing at a B2B company with a developer-focused audience and both self-serve and enterprise motions.

  • Track record of owning full-funnel measurement: connecting top-of-funnel spend to signups to pipeline, and using that to make investment calls, not just channel-level reporting.

  • Proven ability to rank and reallocate spend + efforts across channels based on ROI, and to kill or scale channels based on evidence.

  • Experience evaluating and managing agency relationships and a marketing tool stack, with the judgment to know what to keep versus replace.

  • Comfortable identifying, testing, and standing up entirely new channels rather than only running the established playbook.

  • Strong cross-functional operator: able to work with Product on in-product growth signals, with Sales/SDR on lead quality and funnel handoff, and with Product Marketing and Ecosystem Marketing on execution you delegate out.

  • Efficiency-obsessed: instinctively pressure-tests where a dollar or a headcount is going before committing to it.

  • Familiarity with AI-powered or AI-assisted growth initiatives.

  • Ability to be in office in SF or NYC 3x a week.

     

Nice to Haves

  • Startup experience building a growth function from 0 to 1, standing up measurement and channel testing where little existed, not just optimizing an established program.

  • Has built and led a team, or is ready to hire and manage one as the highest-ROI areas justify dedicated headcount.

  • Experience in crypto/Web3 or blockchain infrastructure marketing.

  • Experience marketing an API-first or infrastructure product.

About Alchemy

Alchemy is the Web3 infrastructure and developer platform that powers millions of users and the world’s most innovative blockchain applications. About the Role

We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager, Platform to launch targeted campaigns across Alchemy's full platform, from product launches to new vertical and segment pushes, and to own the always-on content that fills the gaps in between. This is a high-ownership, high-influence seat with a long runway: you'll start as an executional hire, but there's a real path to Product Marketing Lead and to building a team under you if that's the direction you want to grow.

Alchemy isn't just infrastructure, it's a full platform: building blocks for reads, writes, launching custom chains, and more, spanning verticals from crypto-native builders to traditional finance moving assets onchain. Every campaign we run, whether it's a product launch, a new vertical push, or a piece of evergreen content, needs to tie back to one thing: Alchemy as the platform builders trust to build the future on. You'll own that positioning day to day, from the company-level narrative down to how a single launch is framed, working closely with Lisa (Product Marketing) especially early on as you build that domain authority.

You'll run point end to end: strategy, tactics, project management, measurement, and reporting, on everything from major campaigns to the product launches, newsletter beats, and social content that run continuously. You can and should delegate execution (design, technical content with DevRel, and more), but you own the outcome. When there's no active campaign, you're not idle: you own a pillar of Alchemy's always-on content, filling the gap with mid- and bottom-funnel work that drives activation and cross-sell across our existing platform.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Launch targeted campaigns across product launches and new vertical/segment pushes, owning the strategy, the tactics, and the project management from kickoff to report-out.

  • Own and evolve Alchemy's platform positioning: the throughline that connects every campaign back to Alchemy as a frontier leader built for reliability and performance, backed by real customer stories.

  • Own a pillar of Alchemy's always-on content cadence, mid- and bottom-funnel work, product launch beats, and activation/cross-sell content, whenever there isn't an active campaign in market.

  • Go deep on individual product areas and wide across the full platform, building the kind of product and audience understanding that lets you spot the next campaign or market opportunity before anyone asks for it.

  • Generate and pitch ideas for breaking into new markets and verticals, backed by a real read on the audience and the competitive landscape.

  • Partner with DevRel to produce the technical content (docs-adjacent explainers, videos, tutorials) that supports a campaign or fills a content gap.

  • Bring creative, visual thinking to launches that could otherwise be a dry API announcement, pushing for the campaign concept, not just the campaign checklist.

  • Delegate execution to design, agencies, and other specialists as needed, while remaining accountable for the outcome, the timeline, and the numbers.

  • Build stakeholder trust across Product, Engineering, and DevRel, so that partner teams want to work with you again.

 

What we’re looking for

  • Experience selling to developers on a technical, API-first product with a developer dashboard, not a B2B SaaS platform candidates sign up for and self-manage. This is a hard requirement.

  • A track record of owning a campaign end to end: you can walk through, in detail, how you align stakeholders, launch, measure, and report on a campaign from a template through to results.

  • Genuine curiosity and a love of learning: going deep on a single product area and wide across an entire platform both excite you.

  • Creative instincts: you notice good brand and campaign work in the wild, and you bring visual or conceptual ideas that make a technical launch land.

  • Experience leading a large, high-visibility project end to end, e.g., a website overhaul, a rebrand, or a sales enablement overhaul.

  • Strong cross-functional operator: Product and Engineering partners trust you and want to work with you again.

  • Bias for speed and pragmatism: you default to "how do I get this out the door as fast and sharply as possible," not "how do I make this perfect."

  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI and how it's changing marketing and the developer tools landscape.

     

Nice to Haves

  • Experience marketing to enterprise customers, especially financial services.

  • Breadth of experience marketing to developers across crypto/Web3 verticals.

  • Experience as a software engineer prior to marketing.

  • Leadership or management experience, or a clear interest in growing into it.

About The Role

We’re looking for an Accounts Payable Specialist to join our Finance team and take ownership of daily AP activities, including accurate invoice coding, timely payments, vendor support, and reconciliations.

Reporting to our Procurement Manager, you’ll partner with Accounting and teams across Alchemy to keep our procure-to-pay process running smoothly across Zip, NetSuite, and Ramp.   • Support vendor onboarding and maintain accurate vendor records, including tax forms, addresses, payment terms, and verified banking information.

  • Investigate and resolve invoice discrepancies, duplicate charges, missing credits, and payment issues; escalate exceptions when needed.

  • Review employee expenses and corporate card transactions in Ramp for accurate coding, receipts, approvals, and policy compliance.

Close Support & Special Projects

jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Role

Our Customer Engineering team works closely with Alchemy's customers to ensure a great user experience to help them maximize the value they get from the platform. You will manage the relationship from the start to ensure a smooth on-boarding experience and set up customers for ongoing success. You will ensure prompt and effective resolution of questions, problems, and requests. You will use your first-hand knowledge of our customers to inform our product roadmap and aggregate feedback to product and engineering teams.

In this role specifically, you will work directly with our Account Abstraction and Wallet Services team to provide hands on product specific customer support, scale this support system, and shape feedback into product decisions.

This role is meant for someone with a technical background who is looking to work with multiple sides of the business, with the main focus on delivering results for customers.

  • Scale support through internal tooling and runbooks as well as contribute to devX improvements

  • Understand customer needs and how to meet unique challenges and goals

  • Determine gaps and new features we should build to iterate and improve our offering, partnering with internal teams to drive long term solutions

  • Be the voice of the customers

  • Build and maintain ongoing relationships with complex stakeholders, both internally and externally

  • Work in a quickly changing environment

  • Drive referrals from our customers

What We're Looking For:

  • 1+ years of experience in a software development role

  • Technical degree

  • Experience and interest in Account Abstraction / Wallet Services

  • Strong analytical skills

  • Ability to understand and troubleshoot complex technical issues

  • Strong communication skills with internal and external stakeholders

  • Excellent people skills to monitor and measure customer performance

  • Interest in technology, blockchain, crypto

  • Experience with blockchain a large plus

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Alchemy

Alchemy is the Web3 infrastructure and developer platform that powers millions of users and the world’s most innovative blockchain applications. From enabling $1+ trillion in financial transactions worldwide to scaling L2s and enabling DeFi, Alchemy provides the infrastructure and tools developers need to build reliable, scalable, and accessible experiences.

Trusted by companies like JPMorgan, Stripe, Visa, Franklin Templeton, Nike, and backed by a16z, Coatue, Silver Lake, Lightspeed, and Stanford University, Alchemy is building the foundational layer for a decentralized and AI-enabled Web3 ecosystem. For more information, visit alchemy.com.


The Role

We are hiring a software engineer on the Developer Experience team. You will own projects from the first problem statement through production, and measure whether they worked.

The team owns how developers discover, adopt, and operate Alchemy: the dashboard, APIs, SDKs, CLI, and MCP server that sit between our infrastructure and the people building on it. A growing share of those users are coding agents, so we design for both.

Recent work spans enterprise controls, management APIs, developer observability, onboarding, and self-serve growth. Ahead of us is the shift to agents that discover tools, write code, pay for services with x402, and operate onchain infrastructure on their own.

Our stack: TypeScript, Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, Temporal, Kafka, AWS, and Kubernetes.

What You Will Work On

  • Agent-native developer tools: our CLI, SDKs, MCP server, x402 payments, and Agent Wallets.

  • Enterprise capabilities for teams running production traffic: organizations, roles, SSO, key management, audit history, and spend controls.

  • Public and management APIs for usage, billing, apps, and teams, used by developers, internal tools, and coding agents.

  • Developer observability and product quality: usage analytics, request logs, alerts, and the reliability of the surfaces developers use every day.


What You Will Do

  • Own projects from problem definition through design, launch, measurement, and on-call.

  • Design APIs with clear versioning, error handling, safe defaults, and backwards compatibility.

  • Build data models and services that stay correct and reliable as traffic and customer needs grow, with security built in for users, agents, and services.

  • Build the user-facing side of your features across our dashboard, CLI, and SDKs, so developers and coding agents can discover and use them safely.

  • Instrument what you ship. Use activation, adoption, and conversion data, plus direct developer feedback, to decide what to build next.

  • Write design docs, runbooks, and developer-facing documentation. Review code and technical designs to keep quality high.

  • Work with Product, Billing, Security, Growth, and other engineering teams.


What Success Looks Like

At six months, you have:

  • Execution: Scoped, designed and shipped a project across our APIs, backend services, and dashboard or CLI, and paying customers use it in production.

  • Ownership: Joined on-call and handled incidents in your area without escalating. Your launches ship with alerts, a runbook and a rollback plan.

  • Impact: Moved a number you can name, such as feature adoption, free-to-paid upgrades, time to first API call, or support tickets.

  • Team: Earned the team’s trust by making sound technical decisions, collaborating across functions, and improving code and design quality.

  • Direction: Proposed what the team should build next, backed by usage data and conversations with developers.


Helpful Experience

  • Blockchain experience is helpful, not required.

  • Developer platforms, API products, cloud consoles, or enterprise developer tools, including SDKs, CLIs, MCP servers, agent tools, or machine-readable documentation.

  • Billing, metering, or pricing systems.

  • Temporal or another workflow orchestration system, plus caching and analytical data systems.

  • Observability, incident response, and performance optimization.

  • Blockchain products or developer tools, or agent payment and identity standards such as x402.

  • Open source contributions, talks, or technical writing.

💪 Gym Reimbursement

🚅 Commuter Benefits

🌴 Flexible Time Off

🥙 In-Office Group Meals

🧠 Learning & Development Stipend
